Great — thanks for confirming, Elena. Short answers and an updated unit-econ note below.

Unit economics (pilot-level):
- Assumptions: mixed model footprint (chat + summarization), average token length per request ~1.2k tokens, monthly volume 40M tokens.
- Hosted (committed tier) estimate: $2,200 - $2,900 per 1M tokens (includes inference + prefix caching benefits for summary workloads).
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) estimate: ~$1,600 - $2,400 per 1M tokens (requires 3-month minimum commit and includes autoscaling headroom).
- Typical added costs to budget: premium SLAs (+10-15%), monitoring/longer retention add-ons.

Recommendation: For pilot clarity, propose we put the acceptance target at $3,000/1M tokens (hosted committed option) with an explicit clause to revisit pricing on scale. That keeps us within your stated target while giving you room to validate latency/quality.

Attached is a one-page breakout (also in the pricing sheet): highlights, assumptions, and a sample monthly cost at 40M tokens.

Next steps I propose:
- Samir: if PO/terms look standard, can you confirm dealer code and any specific invoicing fields we should include?
- Marissa / Marcus (CC'd): can you prepare a short finance-friendly one-pager (1 page) that maps the two options (hosted vs dedicated) to recurring cost, one-time onboarding, and suggested acceptance metric (cost/latency)? We can send that straight to Samir and Elena.

If that works I’ll schedule the Sep 15 finance walkthrough (30m) and send calendar invite.

Best,
Aditya
